content: al harassment of women in the workplace and highlighting the importance and significance of the act. 17/04/2023 Sanitary Vending Machine Awareness Program An awareness program was held from 9/12/23 to 14/12/23 based on UGC Guidelines, highlighting key elements of workplace sexual harassment, preventive authorities, sanitary pad disposal bins and vending machines.
